headline: TUSAŞ Targets Year-End First Flight for KAAN Jet Prototype
summary: Turkish Aerospace Industries is preparing the P1 prototype of its KAAN fighter jet for an initial flight targeted before the end of the year.
why: Turkish Aerospace Industries (TUSAŞ) leads Turkey's state defense manufacturing, developing indigenous aerospace platforms to reduce reliance on external suppliers.
